news.title: U.S. crude oil tops $80 per barrel as escalating Iran war disrupts global fuel supplies
news.description: Oil prices have surged about 20% this week as the U.S.-Iran war engulfs the Middle East.

news.title: Trump taps Sen. Markwayne Mullin to replace Kristi Noem as DHS secretary
news.description: Kristi Noem faced criticism for the killing of two American citizens by federal agents, her relationship with Corey Lewandowski, and a $220 million ad campaign.

news.title: The February jobs numbers are coming out Friday. Here's what to expect
news.description: Economists surveyed by Dow Jones expect payroll growth of 50,000, following January's surprisingly high 130,000.
